evals.name: finalize-existing-pr-on-development
evals.expected_output: Skill should detect existing draft PR #99 (base=main), regenerate title to 'Development → Main', regenerate body from the 3 commits, and run `gh pr ready 99`. No `gh pr create`. No `--base` edit (base already correct). No push (local in sync).

evals.name: fix-wrong-base-on-mission-branch
evals.expected_output: Skill should detect existing draft PR #100 with base=main (WRONG for a mission branch), run `gh pr edit 100 --base development` to fix it, push the local-ahead commit first, regenerate title from latest commit subject, regenerate body, and run `gh pr ready 100`.

evals.name: create-new-pr-fallback-on-fix-branch
evals.expected_output: No existing PR — skill should fall through to create path: push -u origin fix/some-bug, then `gh pr create --draft --base development --head fix/some-bug --title 'Fix off-by-one in chunker' --body '<Summary+Test plan>'`, then `gh pr ready <new>`. Must route to `development`, not `main`.
